```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

```

Importer les données
```{r}

landmarks <- read_excel("data/Date_landmarks_20essais.xlsx") |>
  select(PARTENAIRE, ENVIRONNEMENT, YEAR, DEBUT_CW, FIN_CW, FLORAISON, DUREE_CW, DUREE_FLO)

hiver |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = DUREE_CW, colour = ENVIRONNEMENT)) +
  geom_point()

hiver |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = annee, y = as.numeric(yday(debut) - make_date(year(yday(debut)), 9, 1)), colour = lieux)) +
  geom_point()

```
